Round 1: your story
Write your leadership story with numbers.
A stranger can repeat your story back accurately after one hearing. Field check: team size and result are stated.
Round 2: delivery
Say it aloud under a minute.
You finish in about a minute and it sounds like you, not a script. Field check: clear and calm.
Round 3: the hard question
Prepare the failure story.
Your answer to the question you fear holds up without notes. Field check: a real lesson and a changed habit.
Round 4: full mock
Mock with five follow-ups.
You keep the same facts when a follow-up changes the angle. Field check: steady on function and AI.
